CampBuddy · Promo Reels

5 reel ideas, real app screens ke saath

Captions ke peeche CampBuddy ke asli screens hain (WordCamp Rajasthan 2026), halki zoom-motion ke saath, aur har scene voice-over ki line ke saath badalta hai. Neeche phone-mockups khud chalte hain; screen record karo, "Awaaz on" se Hindi mein khud bol kar sunata hai. Har phone ke saath poora scene-by-scene script bhi hai.

Tip: Phone ko vertical hi record karna. "Awaaz on" ek time pe sirf ek hi phone mein karna. Ye browser ki built-in Hindi awaaz hai (robotic sunegi). Final videos (mp4/) mein asli voice-over (MP3/) laga hai, scene usi ke saath sync hain; exact timestamps scripts.md / .srt files mein hain.
Brand colours aur logo asli app se; feature screens CampBuddy ke asli screens hain: WordCamp Rajasthan 2026 ka public schedule aur sponsors, Camp Card pe Sunil Kumar, WordPress Engineer. Matching screen ke log kaalpanik hain.
